what_this_is: The row-count ceiling of each PERMANENT no-verdict class in the SystemVerilog corpus adjudication, and the argument every member of the class joins. corpus_verdict_coverage.py REFUSES a run in which a permanent class holds more rows than its ceiling; the gate SV-CORPUS-DENOMINATOR re-runs the instrument on every commit, so the refusal reaches the pre-commit hook.
how_to_raise: Only in the same commit as the rows that need it, and only by naming which argument below the new rows join (or by adding a NEW argument as a new class, which is a code change to the adjudicator and the instrument, owned by a task leaf). Never raise a ceiling to make a run green.
measured_at: 2026-09-03, PGEN-SV-CORPUS-GRAD-0344 — the four counts are exactly the ones .13a measured on 2026-08-11 (302 rows, 1.8 %); PGEN-SV-CORPUS-GRAD-0345 (.13c.1) added not_source_text at its measured count, 350 (346 friscv $readmemh images + 3 slang string-literal fixtures + 1 Surelog command line), all previously counted as DARK chained_only

deferred:svpp_owned.argument: conformance owned by the preprocessor lane, by the two-parser design; the parser never sees the construct

deferred:impl_varying.argument: the suite contract marks the verdict implementation-dependent (ispras TYPE VARYING); the LRM leaves it to the implementation

deferred:verilog_ams_lane.argument: Verilog-AMS is a different language (-gverilog-ams); owned by the parked VERILOG-AMS tree

deferred:ni_unimplemented.argument: the upstream runner marks the construct Not Implemented and skips it; no expectation exists

deferred:not_source_text.argument: the bytes are not source text in any language this grammar describes (a $readmemh memory image per IEEE 1800-2017 §21.4, a bare string literal, a tool command line) - decided from the file's bytes by adjudicate_external_corpus.py::not_source_text(), never from a list; no key, chaining or grammar revision can yield a verdict about SystemVerilog from them (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.13c.1)
